typography.notes: Outfit provides a sleek, modern, slightly technical feel suitable for a modern gaming tool. Inter ensures high legibility for dense card data.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use crisp, cardless designs for lists. For floating panels, use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-slate-900/80 and a 1px border-slate-700/50.

layouts.search_panel: w-full lg:w-2/5 h-full border-r border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 flex flex-col
layouts.workspace_panel: w-full lg:w-3/5 h-full bg-slate-900 flex flex-col

components.card_list_item: H-12 flex items-center justify-between px-3 border-b border-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800 cursor-pointer transition-colors. Use absolute positioning for mana cost symbols.
components.mana_curve_chart: Use Recharts BarChart. X-axis: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7+. Y-axis: count. Bar color: primary gold or dynamic based on deck colors. Transparent background.
components.color_distribution: Use Recharts PieChart/Donut. Colors must exactly match the mana_accents colors.
components.stat_widget: bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center

motion.card_preview: Scale up slightly and add ambient shadow on hover
motion.list_reorder: Use framer-motion layout animations for smooth drag-and-drop visual feedback

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against slate-900/950 meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='card-search-input', data-testid='add-to-mainboard-button').

hero_background.description: Subtle dark abstract texture for landing page background or empty states.

marketing_feature_1.description: Cards on table for the 'Build Your Ultimate Deck' feature section.

marketing_feature_2.description: Dark mode analytics dashboard for the 'Analyze Your Mana Curve' feature section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'recharts' for the Mana Curve Bar Chart and Color Distribution Pie Chart.
Install '@hello-pangea/dnd' or '@dnd-kit/core' for drag-to-reorder cards functionality.
Use Scryfall API (https://api.scryfall.com/cards/search) for card searching and fetching high-res images.
Implement a responsive layout: on desktop, use the split-screen view. On mobile, use tabs to switch between 'Search' and 'Deck' views.
For the decklist, use a highly condensed row design. Show the mana cost using colored circles or SVGs.
Implement a hover state on decklist items that displays the full card image in a floating tooltip (use Radix HoverCard or similar).
Use Shadcn UI components for Dropdowns (filtering), Tabs (Mainboard/Sideboard/Commander), and Dialogs (share link, settings).
Ensure 'My Decks' dashboard uses a masonry or CSS grid layout to display saved decks as sleek cards with their color identity prominently featured.
Do not use generic centered text alignment. Always left-align data and lists.
Avoid using complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals; always use slate-900 with borders and high blur.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Always add GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.
